xBRIEFInfo.description: Deft Directive work plan. Converted from legacy flat format to vBRIEF v0.5. Schema home for plan["x-directive/interviewContinuation"] (#5352 Prefer-A Bound): targetDeliverable, phase (planning-draft-approved|correction-or-gap-review|artifact-approved|deferred-resume), reopenableDecisionSet, acceptedDeferrals, confirmations[] (artifact/phase require target+revisionId; no single approval object), deltaUnderReview, optional operatorAdoptionMarkers. Absent/omitted means initialize on first delta (not refuse); incomplete present carrier refuses.
